3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set with Sealed Storage

The 3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set provides practical feeding solutions for babies aged 7-12 months. This portable set includes microwave-safe bowls with sealed storage boxes, designed for complementary food introduction and everyday use.

Safe PP Material Construction

Crafted from PVC-free PP material, these feeding bowls meet safety standards for baby products. The durable construction withstands daily use, microwave heating, and regular cleaning. The patchwork pattern adds visual interest during feeding time.

60ML Capacity Square Design

Each bowl holds 60ML of food, suitable for serving purees, cereals, and complementary foods. The square shape provides stability on flat surfaces, reducing spills during self-feeding practice. The compact size fits easily in diaper bags for on-the-go feeding.

Microwave-Safe with Sealed Storage

Heat prepared meals directly in these microwave-safe bowls without transferring food between containers. The sealed storage boxes keep pre-prepared meals fresh in the refrigerator, simplifying meal prep routines. Lids prevent spills during transport and maintain food freshness.

Portable Feeding Solution

The lightweight design makes this set practical for travel, daycare, and visits to family. The three-piece configuration provides multiple bowls for different foods or meal prep throughout the day. Suitable for babies transitioning to solid foods between 7-12 months of age.

Product Specifications

  • Material: PVC-free PP
  • Capacity: 60ML per bowl
  • Shape: Square
  • Quantity: 3 pieces
  • Age Range: 7-12 months
  • Features: Microwave-safe, sealed storage, portable

products.body_html:
PORTABLE BABY DINING SEAT FOR SAFE MEALTIME ANYWHERE

The Portable Baby Dining Seat solves the challenge of finding safe, clean seating when dining away from home. This foldable harness seat attaches securely to most chairs, giving your child a stable and comfortable place to sit during meals at restaurants, family gatherings, or while traveling.

Made from durable Oxford cloth with sponge padding, this dining seat provides proper support for children aged 1-3 years. The compact design folds into a storage bag measuring 30cm x 25cm x 8cm, making it easy to carry in a diaper bag or backpack. Safety straps and buckles keep your child secure while the wipeable surface handles spills without staining.

WHAT MAKES THE PORTABLE DINING CHAIR BAG DIFFERENT

✅ ALL-IN-ONE FUNCTION—It acts as a storage bag and a baby dining chair, reducing the need for multiple bulky items. This makes it ideal for parents who love efficiency and organization.

✅ FOLDABLE & LIGHTWEIGHT—It is compact enough to carry in one hand or slip into a travel bag. Parents can set it up anywhere, making dining on the go seamless and stress-free.

✅ SECURE DESIGN – Equipped with strong straps and safety buckles, the Portable Dining Chair Bag keeps children stable and comfortable during meals. This reassures parents that their little ones are safe even in unfamiliar environments.

✅ COMFORTABLE SEATING – Padded construction gives kids proper support while sitting. This helps them stay at the table longer, reducing fussiness and making mealtime more enjoyable.

✅ EASY TO CLEAN—The Portable Dining Chair Bag is made of wipeable materials that resist stains and spills. Parents save time cleaning, keeping the Bag fresh for the next outing.

SIMPLE TO USE PORTABLE DINING CHAIR BAG

1. Unfold the Portable Dining Chair Bag and secure it to a chair.

2. Fasten the safety straps snugly around your child.

3. Store small items in its built-in pockets.

4. Fold it back up into a bag when mealtime is over.

The built-in storage pockets hold essentials like utensils, bibs, and wipes. Available in Sky Blue, Light Yellow, and Pink, this travel-friendly seat adapts to various dining situations while maintaining consistent safety and comfort standards.

products.title: Silicone Baby Bottle Brush Set with Storage Box - Food Grade Cleaning Kit
products.body_html:
Bottol Silicone Baby Bottle Brush Set combines hygienic, durable design with a convenient storage box to create the perfect cleaning solution for modern families. This thoughtfully designed set ensures every bottle, nipple, and straw is thoroughly cleaned, keeping your baby's feeding essentials safe and ready for daily use.

Complete Baby Bottle Cleaning Solution

This premium food-grade silicone brush set provides thorough cleaning for all baby feeding accessories. The soft silicone bristles effectively clean without scratching delicate bottle surfaces, while the ventilated storage box maintains hygiene between uses.

Smart Design Features

  • Soft silicone bristles provide thorough cleaning without scratching bottles
  • Durable construction ensures long-lasting use compared to traditional brushes
  • Ergonomic handle offers a secure, comfortable grip during washing
  • Multi-functional brush heads designed for bottles, nipples, and straws
  • Ventilated storage box keeps brushes organized and hygienic between uses
  • Quick-dry design prevents odor and bacteria build-up

Setup and Usage

  • Rinse brushes with warm water before first use
  • Use bottle brush for standard and wide-neck bottles
  • Switch to nipple or straw brush for smaller feeding accessories
  • After washing, rinse brushes and place back into the storage box
  • Clean brushes regularly to maintain hygiene

Product Specifications

  • Material: Premium food-grade silicone & durable ABS handle
  • Included Set: Bottle brush, nipple brush, straw brush, storage box
  • Style: Soft bristle, ergonomic design with ventilated storage
  • Colors: Classic White, Fresh Mint, Baby Pink
  • Suitable for: All types of baby bottles, nipples, and feeding accessories

Why Choose This Brush Set

  • Gentle yet effective cleaning for baby bottles and accessories
  • Silicone bristles outlast traditional sponges or nylon brushes
  • Hygienic storage box prevents mess and keeps brushes fresh
  • Easy to clean and maintain for everyday use
  • Compact and space-saving, perfect for modern homes
